- Use the "外國專業人員工作許可申辦網" (https://ezwp.wda.gov.tw) to apply online for a student work permit. [3]
- The website offers 24‑hour online submission, payment, notification, and inquiry services. [3]
- You can also use the "外國人在臺工作服務網" (https://ezworktaiwan.wda.gov.tw) to check the application progress. [3]
- For further assistance, call the Labor Development Agency at 02‑8995‑6000. [3]

- If a student works without a permit, they may be fined up to NT$150,000. [4]
- If the employer hires the student without a permit, the employer may be fined up to NT$750,000. [4]

- Use the "行動裝置檢視下載" (Download the Electronic Service of student Work Permit) feature to view the work permit on your mobile device. [3]
- Confirm the case information before printing or downloading the PDF file. [3]

- Foreign students who earn an associate degree or higher in Taiwan can apply to extend their stay for up to two years. [1]
- During this extended stay, graduates can work without a separate work permit, and family members can also apply to remain in Taiwan. [1]
- Employers do not need to separately apply to the Ministry of Labor for work permits during the extended stay. [1]
- Graduates can work in any field as long as they comply with labor laws, and after the extended stay ends, they can transition to other residency programs based on a points system or regulations governing foreign professionals. [1]

- The hotline number is 1990 [1]
- It is called the Foreigners in Taiwan Life Consultation Service Hotline (外來人士在臺生活諮詢服務熱線) [1]

- Call 165 for anti-fraud consultation. [4]
- Remember the 3C principle: Calm Down, Check it out, Call 165. [4]

- The employer must pay 4 times the labor insurance premium for each month the student worker is not insured. [1]
- The employer must pay 10 times the employment insurance premium for each month the student worker is not insured. [1]

- A bachelor's degree takes four years and at least 128 credits in total. [3]
- The University adopts the system of academic years and course credits. [3]
- Contact: Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw [3]

- 12 extra credits must be earned on top of the usual requirements. [4]
- Military training and PE do not count toward these 12 credits. [4]
- This requirement applies to foreign, Hong Kong, and Macau undergraduates whose graduating grades and schools are equivalent to Taiwan's second grade of senior high school. [4]
- For details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [4]

- At least 16 credits each semester in years one to three. [5]
- At least 9 credits each semester in year four. [5]

- International students must take the full‑year five‑credit course “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” (僑生國文) instead of the regular Chinese (A) and Chinese (B) courses. [1]
- This course counts as the required 5 credits for the Chinese requirement. [1]
- Students who complete “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” are not required to take “Chinese (B): Chinese Writing.” [1]
- For details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- 6 credits of Mandarin courses at the Language Center [2]
- File for the Chinese course substitution before graduation [2]
- This differs from Article 3 of the common-course regulations (5 credits of Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students) [2]

- PE is required for five semesters: Freshman PE I and II plus three PE interest electives. [3]
- The five semesters do not count toward graduation credits. [3]
- You may take an additional 1-credit PE course after the five semesters, but it also does not count toward graduation credits. [3]
- Interest electives cannot be repeated with the same title. [3]

- A master's degree requires at least 24 credits, not counting thesis credits. [4]
- You must also take at least one graduate course of 1 credit or more at NCU; waived courses do not count. [4]

- At least 34 credits in total, with at least 18 of those being doctoral-level credits. [5]
- Dissertation credits are not included in this count. [5]
- This requirement is specified in National Central University Study Regulations, Article 58. [5]
- For details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [5]

- Apply before the add/drop deadline of your first semester. [1]
- If approved, you skip both semesters and receive 6 credits that count toward graduation. [1]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Undergraduates must complete at least 100 service hours on the NCU passport (中大護照 100 基本時數) before receiving the degree certificate. [2]
- You can check your hours on the Service Learning Website (服務學習網) or in the Graduation System (畢業審核系統). [2]
- For any questions, contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心). [2]
- The announcement is in the 114 academic year, second semester (114 學年度第 2 學期頒發學位證書相關注意事項) and was issued on 115 年 2 月 12 日. [2]

- Service learning is not listed as a graduation condition for master's and doctoral students. [4]
- The graduation conditions are courses and credits, the degree examination, and conduct grades. [4]
- Individual departments may still set their own requirements. [4]
- Contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/) for details. [4]

- The service-learning course must be taken in two semesters. [5]
- The two course numbers must be different. [5]
- It carries no credits. [5]
- For details, contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心) at https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/. [5]

- TOEFL ITP: 543 (admitted 115 or later) [2]
- TOEFL ITP: 483 (admitted 114 or earlier) [2]
- BESTEP: 64 分；2026-01-21 起的新制成績為 3.5 級 (admitted 110 or later) [2]

- The program requires an English proficiency certificate at CEFR B1 (Threshold) or above. [3]
- The program is taught entirely in English. [3]
- The program requires 24 credits, with 18 elective credits and 6 required credits. [3]
- The program lasts 2 years. [3]

- The Ph.D. in Institute of Network Learning Technology is offered by the College of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (資電學院) [4]
- The program requires 4 years of study, 24 credits, 24 elective credits, and 0 required credits [4]
- The teaching language is English sufficient [4]
- The regulations can be found at https://www.lst.ncu.edu.tw/NLT_new/page.php?slug=method&lang=en [4]
- Call ext. 57081 [2]
- Mon-Fri 9:00-17:00 (Taipei time, UTC+8) [1]

- The extension for visiting student programs (IIPP, TEEP) is +886-3-425-4945 ext. 57080 [3]
- The office is located at 1F, Teaching and Research Building, No. 300, Zhongda Rd., Zhongli District, Taoyuan City 320317 [3]
- Office hours are Mon-Fri 9:00-17:00 (Taipei time, UTC+8) [3]

- Take bus 132 or 133 from any campus stop towards Zhongli; the ride takes about 20–30 minutes. [5]
- Route 132 ends at Zhongli Bus Station, a short walk from the train station. [5]
- The train station is located at 139, Zhonghe Rd., Zhongli Dist., Taoyuan City. [5]
- Directions from NCU: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=24.9684%2C121.1916&destination=24.9533168%2C121.2261602&travelmode=transit [5]

- Monthly stipend of NT$10,000 (up to 2 years, sponsored by our industry partners) [4]

- Eligible nationalities: Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand [1]
- The program is offered by the Department of Mechanical Engineering [1]
- The program is taught in English [1]
- Application Period (Spring 2027 Semester): Open from October 1 to October 22, 2026, closing strictly at 5:00 PM (GMT+8). [5]

- Bring your student ID (學生證) or passport/residence permit (護照/居留證) for verification. [1]
- Go to the OIA counter, state your name and the package type (掛號/平信). [1]
- Bring the package list (Package List). [1]

- The package collection counter is located at the International Affairs Office (教學研究大樓 1F) [2]
- It is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 [2]
- Apply for Student Loans from Aug. 1 to Sep. 9 [1]
- Aug. 31- Sep. 4 Orientation Week for New International Students [2]

- The fee for a first‑time application for a Hong Kong or Macau student is NT$1,000 for a one‑year residence certificate. [2]
- The entry‑exit permit fee is NT$600 for a single entry‑exit permit. [2]
- The application requires a Hong Kong or Macau permanent resident ID, residence certificate original and copy, a recent two‑inch photo, a copy of the residence certificate front and back, a copy of the student ID front and back, and the certificate fee. [2]

- If you have not yet met the National Health Insurance (全民健保) eligibility, you must pay TWD 3,000 for a six‑month (one semester) Cathay Life medical insurance. [2]
- The OCAC insurance period ends when you become eligible for National Health Insurance. [2]
- For details on the insurance, refer to the "Medical Insurance for Overseas Chinese Students" PDF: https://oia.ncu.edu.tw/static/file/26/1026/img/279/cathayInsurance.pdf. [2]
- The OCAC insurance and Cathay Life insurance are both governed by the "Medical Insurance for Overseas Chinese Students" guidelines: https://law.ocac.gov.tw/law/LawContent.aspx?id=GL000156&kw=%e5%83%91%e7%94%9f%e5%82%b7%e7%97%85%e9%86%ab%e7%99%82%e4%bf%9d%e9%9a%aa%e4%bd%9c%e6%a5%ad%e8%a6%81%e9%bb%9e. [2]

- TWD 4,494 per six months for National Health Insurance [3]
- After subsidy, the cost is TWD 2,244 per six months [3]

- The monthly National Health Insurance premium for Mainland Chinese students is TWD 1,377. [4]
- Mainland Chinese students must pay 60% of the premium, which is TWD 826. [4]
- The government pays the remaining 40%, which is TWD 551. [4]

- The application period for the NCU Scholarship for Fall 2026 Semester started on July 6th and ended on July 20th, 12:00 PM, 2026. [1]
- Only international students who were admitted in the Spring 2026 Semester (excluding non-recipients of the NCU Scholarship or dual-degree program students) are eligible to apply. [1]

- 依移民法第22條第2項規定，外國人持居留簽證入國者，應於入國後之翌日起算30日內，申請外僑居留證。 [4]
- 依外國人停留居留及永久居留辦法第11條規定，來臺就學之外國人畢業後，於居留期限屆滿前，得申請延期居留。經許可者，其外僑居留證之有效期間自原居留期限屆滿之翌日起延期1年；延期屆滿前，有必要者，得再申請延期居留1次，總延期居留期間最長為2年。 [4]

- Dịch vụ hỗ trợ có thể được cung cấp bằng tiếng Trung, tiếng Anh, tiếng Nhật, tiếng Việt, tiếng Ấn Độ, tiếng Thái, tiếng Campuchia. [1]

- Sinh viên đại học cần hoàn thành ít nhất 100 giờ dịch vụ trên hộ chiếu NCU trước khi nhận bằng tốt nghiệp. [3]

- Nếu chưa đạt 100 giờ, bạn sẽ không được cấp bằng tốt nghiệp. [3]
- Bạn có thể liên hệ với Trung tâm Phát triển Học tập (Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs) tại https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/ để được hỗ trợ. [3]

- Tuyến 132 kết thúc tại Zhongli Bus Station, đi bộ ngắn tới ga tàu. [1]
